fields.display_title: Clarity 2.2, 2.4: Moreover, the so-called "coverage constraint promotes " above Eqn (6) makes sense for efficiency improvement that reduces communication to the cloud. However, it is unreasonable from the optimization perspective since constraints tell only feasibility. The statements on page 6 before the "Focusing competency and loss functions" paragraph are not convincing. A few examples for illustration will be better.
fields.replying_to: Replying to Clarity 2.2: In the methods section, the authors present a simple supervised solution for the router model in a complicated manner. Most mathematical formulas in this paper are just symbols.

fields.display_title: Clarity 2.3: The statement around Eqn (7) is confusing. The "cov" term even seems unrelated. The "converge" is an upper bound of how many samples need to be delivered to the cloud to achieve a communication efficiency requirement. The authors should explicitly state such a relationship in words.
